data.title: Blueberry Medical (“Blueberry”) Security Incident
data.description: In Mountain View, California, an unauthorized individual took advantage of a critical vulnerability in the Metabase platform on August 10 to gain administrator access to Blueberry's Metabase environment. This incident was part of a larger exploitation of the vulnerability. Blueberry discovered the unauthorized access on August 22 and promptly activated their incident-response procedures. Within about one hour of detection, they successfully stopped the unauthorized access and related sessions.

data.description: On October 9, 2026, Levi & Korsinsky, LLP released a statement addressed to individuals or entities who bought Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: PRTH) stock before September 18, 2026. This notice serves as a notification to all concerned parties.

data.title: Stowers scientist selected for $28.6 million research effort to predict protein changes behind neurodegenerative disease
data.description: In recent news, a team of scientists has received a new award in Kansas City, Mo., on Oct. 9, 2026. This award aims to unite experts in the fields of AI, conducting large-scale experiments, and studying human-cells to forecast detrimental alterations in proteins prior to the onset of diseases. The focus of their research will be on neurodegenerative conditions like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. This initiative combines cutting-edge technology with comprehensive studies to anticipate protein changes and potentially intervene before the manifestation of diseases.

data.title: Alignment Healthcare Investigation Notice: SueWallSt Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into Alignment Healthcare (ALHC)
data.description: Following CMS's announcement of a 3.5-star 2027 rating for the Alignment Healthcare contract that encompasses over 75% of its health-plan members, two Wall Street downgrades were issued. This led to a sharp decline in ALHC's stock, which opened with a drop of approximately 20%. Additionally, an investigation has been initiated to look into possible violations of securities laws. The developments unfolded in New York on October 9, 2026.

data.title: LibertyStream Updates Shareholder Meeting Timing
data.description: Dallas-based LibertyStream Infrastructure Partners Inc. (TSXV: LIB | OTCQB: VLTLF | FSE: I2D) has decided to delay its annual and special shareholder meeting, initially set for October 15, 2026. The meeting will now take place in the latter half of November 2026, with a specific date yet to be confirmed. This postponement aims to align with upcoming business developments within the company and give shareholders ample time to review and assess these updates.

data.title: ME Therapeutics Extends Option Agreement for CD22 Nanobody Asset
data.description: ME Therapeutics Holdings Inc., a biotechnology company based in Vancouver, British Columbia, has extended its option agreement to license the National Research Council of Canada’s proprietary nanobody-based CD22 binder for utilization in Chimeric Antigen Receptor therapy. The company, listed on the CSE as METX and on the FSE as Q9T, focuses on innovative cancer treatments in the immuno-oncology sector. This extension marks a significant advancement in ME Therapeutics' commitment to developing cutting-edge drugs for cancer treatment.

data.title: Service Properties Trust Confirms Receipt of Unsolicited Proposal for Hotel Portfolio From TKO Hotels
data.description: Service Properties Trust, based in Newton, Massachusetts, confirmed receiving an unsolicited $2.0 billion cash offer from TKO LLC to acquire its hospitality portfolio. This offer came without prior contact from TKO. The Company's Board of Trustees will thoroughly assess TKO's proposal to decide on the next steps in the best interest of the company.

data.title: Could Menopause Hold Clues to Women's Alzheimer's Risk?
data.description: A research project funded by a $3.4 million grant from the National Institutes of Health at Rosalind Franklin University aims to investigate the impact of hormonal shifts during perimenopause on memory-related brain circuits. Located in North Chicago, Illinois, the study seeks to address the prevalence of Alzheimer's disease, with women representing about 66% of the total number of Americans affected by the condition. The project, initiated on October 9, 2026, aims to deepen understanding of how hormonal changes in midlife influence cognitive function, particularly in relation to memory processes.

data.title: Pope Francis' Coffee-Painted Portrait by Erguvan Art & Academy CEO Dr. Ali Karatay Presented at the Vatican
data.description: A portrait of Pope Francis formed using coffee was unveiled by artist Dr. Ali Karatay in Woodland, California on October 9, 2026. This unique piece by the CEO of Erguvan Art showcases the artistic ability to bridge cultures and honor our common humanity. The coffee-painted portrait serves as a testament to art's unifying influence, underscoring the potential for creativity to connect individuals across diverse backgrounds.

data.title: CES Properties: A Legacy of Strength, Poised for a New Era of Growth
data.description: A company in Bellevue, Washington, known as CES Properties, is gearing up to mark its 57th anniversary at The Harvest in Woodinville. In a celebratory event planned for October 9, 2026, the firm will also introduce a new brand dedicated to honoring its founder, Ed Springman. With a strong presence in the Pacific Northwest real estate market, CES Properties has established itself as a significant player over the years. This announcement comes as the company shows gratitude towards its investors for their ongoing support.

data.title: Network of Giving Lifts Off in Seattle and Edmonton
data.description: Seattle and Edmonton are the pioneering cities for the launch of Network of Giving, a unique program that enhances community support. This initiative integrates a connected loyalty platform into businesses of varying sizes, facilitating charitable donations, and quantifiable community benefits all through a singular network. Local merchants have the discretion to decide the extent of their contributions towards regional nonprofits, marking a significant step forward in community collaboration and philanthropy.
